verdict.rationale: Martin documents its own background tasks that run on a schedule and return results: daily or weekly briefings by email and morning wake-up calls with the weather and your schedule. Reminders cover one-off timed pings. However, these are preset task types. There is no evidence that a user can schedule an arbitrary recurring or one-off task, such as a custom research or action job, that runs automatically and reports back. missing for 10: user-defined arbitrary scheduled tasks (one-off and recurring), scheduling of shortcuts/multi-step actions, task management or result-delivery details, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can schedule recurring or one-off tasks that run automatically and come back to me with results

citations.quote: Martin can send you daily or weekly briefings via email.
Martin can call you at a specific time every morning to wake you up with the weather and your schedule.
Tell Martin to remind you to do something, and he will ping you at the specified time, via the specified interface.
